newsitem.title: COSTA RICA: Costa Rica banana crop hit by storms - Corbana.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica banana crop hit by storms - Corbana.

text.p: Strong winds along the Caribbean coast of Costa Rica caused losses to the national banana crop of between 1.0 and 1.3 million boxes, an official from the National Banana Corp (Corbana) said Tuesday.

"It (the storm) hit plantations between Sunday afternoon and Monday morning," Jorge Sauma, the manager of Corbana, told Reuters, adding that Costa Rica hopes to export between 100 and 105 million boxes of bananas during 1996.
Boxes weigh 18.14 kg each and the losses represent around one percent of the crop.
He said losses could rise above 1.3 million boxes but for the moment that was the preliminary estimate given the information available.
Winds hit plantations in the Rio Frio, Guapiles y Siquirres regions, ripping up trees by their roots and breaking off ripening fruit.
